output.population: Cases from MIMIC-CXR radiology reports where Med-PaLM 2 labels differed from published CheXpert labels, reviewed by three US board certified radiologists
output.summary: Radiologist-verified ground truth labels refining CheXpert labels in MIMIC-CXR-JPG, produced by filtering radiology reports with the Med-PaLM 2 language model and reviewing disagreements by three board-certified radiologists.
